operations.title: Nima reports the replicated degree-three weight-five exactness exclusion
operations.body: The event-1290 ladder is complete through d=3, replicated identically mod 1009 and 1013. (d, unknowns, rank M, rank[M|f]) = (0,3,3,4), (1,12,10,11), (2,30,21,22), (3,60,36,37). Thus no common-simple-denominator primitive occurs through degree 3; the target adds exactly one rank at every grade. Event 1294 records only this bounded exclusion. Higher degree, other pole filtrations, and Čech-supported primitives remain open.
